summary: a website to make students learn about the forgotten things in space in a more funny and attractive way with stories with the theme of a funny cartoon such as SpongeBob square pans, games, animations that explain the stories, and quizzes with a leaderboard  for each quiz.
details:
It is a website that tells the stories of things humans left behind in space, like the Opportunity rover and the Apollo footprints. Each story has its own page with a photo and facts. Visitors can read the stories, earn badges, take a quiz, and share their own stories.

It makes learning about space history fun and easy. It is free, runs in any browser, and works on phones and computers.

We want people to think about one question: are we exploring new worlds, or creating a new kind of pollution? We hope it makes people curious about space history and about taking care of what we leave behind.

We used HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, plus a code editor and the web browser.

Each object gets its own story page, like a character. a quiz turn reading into a game. Visitors can add their own stories and photos. The dark space theme makes it feel like the night sky.

We made it easy to use on any screen, easy to read, and easy to use with a keyboard. We kept the code simple so pages load fast. We also made sure the facts are correct and the photos are credited.
